init.title: FFBB Tracker Options
init.description: Configure update polling intervals and optionally enable faster polling around match times to get scores sooner.

data_description.scan_interval: Check frequency outside match windows (15 to 1440 min).
data_description.live_polling: Automatically switches to a shorter interval around match times.
data_description.live_scan_interval: Check frequency in fast polling mode (2 to 15 min).
data_description.live_window_after_hours: Duration of fast polling mode after kickoff (1 to 6 h).

season_rollover.title: FFBB Tracker: Team not found
season_rollover.description: The team "{team_name}" has been unavailable on the FFBB API for several days. This typically occurs during season rollovers when the FFBB assigns new engagement and pool IDs. Go to Settings > Devices & services > FFBB Tracker, select this entry, and choose Reconfigure to locate your team again.

entry_not_found.message: No team matches the config entry "{entry_id}". Verify the identifier or omit it to target all tracked teams.

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Forces an immediate coordinator update for FFBB teams.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Specific config entry to refresh. If omitted, all teams are updated.

get_next_matches.name: Get next matches
get_next_matches.description: Returns upcoming matches for use in automations or scripts.

get_standings.name: Get pool standings
get_standings.description: Returns the complete pool standings table.
